title: Serial-to-Parallel Register
statement: Create a serial-to-parallel register that shifts in bits from serial_in on each clock and captures the result when load is asserted. The output holds the current parallel contents. A synchronous reset should clear the register to zero.
module_signature: module serial_to_parallel_register(input clk, input rst, input serial_in, input load, output reg [7:0] q);
behavior: On each rising edge, q shifts left and serial_in enters q[0].
If load is asserted, q presents the accumulated parallel word.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous or combinational latches.
hint: Use a shift register and a load condition in the clocked block.
